what_likely_happened: An attacker compromised user sarah.jenkins via a targeted phishing link, subsequently performing an impossible travel authentication from Romania to hijack the cloud session. The adversary established an email forwarding rule to intercept financial communications and rapidly exfiltrated sensitive audit and payroll archives from a shared server.

evidence.finding: User clicked a phishing lure link.
evidence.detail: User sarah.jenkins accessed external domain login-microsoft-auth.secure-verify.net/reset from host WS-FIN-042.
Successful authentication from Bucharest, Romania 6 minutes after a login in London, UK.

evidence.finding: Malicious inbox rule created for financial espionage.
evidence.detail: Rule configured to forward messages containing 'wire', 'invoice', and 'statement' to an external ProtonMail address.

evidence.finding: High-volume access and download of restricted files.
evidence.detail: 48 restricted financial audit spreadsheets and payroll archives downloaded from SRV-SHARE-01 within 45 seconds.

confidence_reason: Although clear telemetry exists for the attack chain, rule 1 dictates lowering the confidence score below 60% due to the presence of an event (EVT-ROBUST-MISSING_scenario_a) containing missing and fragmented host/user data.

recommended_actions.title: Block Malicious Ingress IP at Perimeter Firewall
recommended_actions.description: Automatically pushed firewall drop rule for 185.220.101.5 (Tor Exit / Geo anomaly).

recommended_actions.title: Revoke Active Sessions & Force Password Reset
recommended_actions.description: Automatically invalidated Entra ID refresh tokens and forced immediate credential change.

recommended_actions.title: Purge Illicit Exchange Forwarding Rule
recommended_actions.description: Automatically deleted mailbox redirect rule to drop-audit-q4@protonmail.com.

recommended_actions.title: Network Isolation of Financial Workstation
recommended_actions.description: Quarantine WS-FIN-042 via EDR to prevent lateral movement. Sever all NIC traffic except EDR heartbeat.

recommended_actions.title: Immediate Enterprise Account Lockout
recommended_actions.description: Disable AD account and freeze all domain privilege tokens pending forensic interview.

analyst_queue_reason: Fragmented telemetry: packet buffer overflow dropped host/user context. Analyst manual review required.
